en: A sepia-toned portrait postcard featuring a bearded man in a suit and bow tie, presented in a formal studio style with his upper body facing slightly to the side. Beneath the image is printed text identifying him, along with his profession and city in French. There is a handwritten date at the top in Greek and extensive handwritten Greek text covering the lower half of the card, typical of an early 20th‑century correspondence postcard.
